## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: ticket-init.sh idempotent — re-running against existing tickets-tracker worktrees that predate this epic adds exclusion entry without duplication or disturbing other entries; covered by behavioral test against pre-upgrade worktree fixture

## Description
Create tests/scratch/test-ticket-init-idempotent.sh. Fabricate a pre-upgrade tickets-tracker fixture (worktree with no `.scratch/` line in .git/info/exclude, plus 2 pre-existing unrelated lines). Run ticket-init.sh twice and assert: (a) `grep -cFx '.scratch/' <exclude>` == 1 after each run; (b) pre-existing 2 lines remain in original positions (diff against baseline excluding the appended line).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Test executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scratch/test-ticket-init-idempotent.sh
- [ ] Test passes against modified ticket-init.sh
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-ticket-init-idempotent.sh
- [ ] Test invokes ticket-init.sh twice
  Verify: [ $(grep -c 'ticket-init.sh' tests/scratch/test-ticket-init-idempotent.sh) -ge 2 ]
- [ ] Test asserts exactly-one .scratch/ entry after both runs
  Verify: grep -qE 'grep -cFx|grep -c' tests/scratch/test-ticket-init-idempotent.sh
- [ ] Test verifies preserved unrelated entries via diff
  Verify: grep -q diff tests/scratch/test-ticket-init-idempotent.sh

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
|---|---|
| tests/scratch/test-ticket-init-idempotent.sh | Create |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 sonnet → opus → user.
